blocks.text: Stepping into a hardware store used to be about buying tools, nails, and traditional brass padlocks. But in today’s fast-paced world, a home is no longer just a physical structure—it is a personal sanctuary. As modern Filipino families navigate busy routines and complex schedules, complete home wellness requires a living space free from daily friction, stress, and anxiety. Building upon the momentum of its initial activations, Yale Home Philippines—under global access solutions leader ASSA ABLOY—partnered with ACE Hardware Philippines at ACE Builders, SM City Fairview to launch the third chapter of its nationwide campaign.
